C0359.title: Midnight Blizzard Password-Spraying Attack Against Microsoft Corporate Systems
C0359.summary: Microsoft disclosed that, beginning in late November 2023, the Russian state-sponsored actor Midnight Blizzard used a password-spraying attack to compromise a legacy non-production test tenant account. The actor used that account's permissions to access a small number of Microsoft corporate email accounts, including senior leadership and cybersecurity and legal staff, and exfiltrated some emails and attachments. Microsoft detected the attack on January 12, 2024 and began its response.
